verdicts.constraint_right: the spatial prior is right; the expression-based (reference) label is wrong
verdicts.reference_right: the expression-based label is right; the prior does not apply here
verdicts.region_wrong: the cell's region assignment is wrong
verdicts.artifact: technical artifact (tissue edge, debris, segmentation, no tissue on H&E)
verdicts.new_state: real cell state not covered by the current cell type taxonomy

depth_note: depth = distance to the mucosa core (epithelial-marker density); 0 inside crypts
region_note: regions are drawn and named by the user; cells outside every region are 'unknown'
